purpose: MC-114 smoke test (design §10): questions written for the smoke, drawn from no benchmark, on corpus_v2 articles that no MC-114 item uses (Luật Đấu thầu 2023 Điều 22 and 27, which no ViBidLQA row of any split names; Luật Khiếu nại 2011 Điều 9, which no VMLU audit provision cites). Each runs once with DSHF and once with OMPF. No score is computed; the run sets the budget and checks both harnesses on corpus_v2.
